alignment.preparation: Pinned 4316998 baseline; every original GB feature retained unchanged. All 90 current Zhejiang counties use complete OSM relation geometry on one shared node mesh. All 13 Hangzhou administrative coordinate arrays unchanged in provenance archive; runtime land uses exact same-snapshot natural=coastline clipping, retaining IDs. The 21 overlapping outside-province GB counties are historical-only; separate stable SEAM IDs subtract the exact verified OSM Zhejiang province, with no other boundary movement. No simplification, buffering, or invented county ownership. Active land is exact unary union. Neutral fallback uses only enclosed inland holes intersecting the 2017 Zhejiang footprint; open/coastal residuals excluded. Country is exact union of active land plus neutral fallback. All90 renderedZhejiangpolygons intersect exact directed2026OSMcoastline landmask; maritime administrative areas remain only in separate90relation provenancearchive. Neutralfallbackexcludes verifiedsea and nearcoastcomponents.

baselineSource.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License 1.0

checks.fallbackRule: Exact 2017 Zhejiang GB union minus active China union, outside raw current province and within enclosed holes; discard whole components within0.01degree of actual2026coastlines. No county assignment or synthetic coast.
checks.historicalFootprintDifferenceMeaning: 2017 Zhejiang footprint minus active whole-China union. This is a source-version difference, not proof of present-day uncovered land.

coastlineEvidence.source: © OpenStreetMap contributors; natural=coastline directed ways from pinned Geofabrik Zhejiang PBF
coastlineEvidence.rule: Polygonize exact coastlines plus administrative outer boundary; discard faces outside province, including foreign enclaves. Land on left, sea on right. All retained coastal faces have directed evidence.
